scope: Four physically linked halls in present-day Sanam Chandra Palace: Bhimarn Prathom with its western-style garden façade, the southern Aphirom Ruedi wing, gilded Vajariromaya Hall with a Thai layered roof, and the northern raised Samakkhi Mukhamat audience hall. Includes the connecting upper-floor galleries and the open central light court.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: The original two-storey Western masonry building has carved railings and vents for the climate; the smaller two-storey Aphirom Ruedi continues south. The two-storey Vajariromaya has stacked glazed tile roofs, a projecting south portico and a porch joined to Bhimarn Prathom. The one-storey Samakkhi Mukhamat is a large audience hall connected to Vajariromaya through a continuing roof.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: The raised northern audience and theater hall has a stair on each side and a north ceremonial gable. Its open veranda is used on three sides.
The local authority records the masonry Bhimarn Prathom, the 1917 two-tiered Vajariromaya, the gilt south porch crest and the terrace between them.
